case_title: Dilbag Rai v. The State of Haryana & Ors.
neutral_facts: The accused entered into an agreement to sell a property and received payment from the complainant. However, the property was not transferred, and the accused did not complete the transaction. The complainant later filed a complaint, leading to the registration of an FIR. During the investigation, it was discovered that the property actually belonged to someone else. The chargesheet was filed under Sections 406 and 420 of the IPC, and the trial commenced. The High Court quashed the proceedings, arguing that the complainant failed to establish criminal intent.
